facts.fact: Ghana's Data Protection Commission, through its Director of Regulatory and Compliance Quintin Akrobotu, ran compliance checks and a week-long enforcement exercise under Section 81 of the Data Protection Act.

The Data Protection Commission directed named companies including Menkish Impex Ltd, Polytex Ghana Limited and JA Biney Packaging to report to the CID and the Commission and regularise their registration, for operating unregistered or with expired certificates.
